meta.title: Kudos Donations demo
meta.description: A demo campaign with a donate button on the front page. Payments are simulated.
meta.author: iseardmedia

steps.code:
get( CampaignRepository::class )->insert( new CampaignEntity( [ 'title' => 'Community Garden', 'goal' => 2500, 'show_goal' => true, 'amount_type' => 'both', 'fixed_amounts' => [ '10', '25', '50', '100' ], 'message_enabled' => true, 'initial_title' => 'Help our community garden grow', 'initial_description' => 'Every donation goes towards seeds, tools and workshops for the neighbourhood.', ] ) ); // A few paid donations (test mode), so the progress bar and the admin tables have content. $donors = $container->get( DonorRepository::class ); $transactions = $container->get( TransactionRepository::class ); foreach ( [ [ 'Sam Jansen', 'sam@example.org', 50 ], [ 'Alex Peeters', 'alex@example.org', 25 ], [ 'Robin de Vries', 'robin@example.org', 100 ] ] as [ $name, $email, $value ] ) { $donor_id = $donors->insert( new DonorEntity( [ 'name' => $name, 'email' => $email, 'mode' => 'test' ] ) ); $transactions->insert( new TransactionEntity( [ 'value' => $value, 'currency' => 'EUR', 'status' => 'paid', 'mode' => 'test', 'vendor' => 'demo', 'campaign_id' => $campaign_id, 'donor_id' => $donor_id, ] ) ); } // A page with the donate button, used as the front page of the demo site. $page_id = wp_insert_post( [ 'post_type' => 'page', 'post_status' => 'publish', 'post_title' => 'Support our community garden', 'post_content' => '

This demo shows Kudos Donations as your visitors see it. Click the button to try a donation: payments in this demo are simulated, no money changes hands.

' . '' . '

To see the other side, go to Donations in the admin.

', ] ); update_option( 'show_on_front', 'page' ); update_option( 'page_on_front', $page_id );
